stem.text: In the circuit shown, lamp P is rated $250\,\text{V}$, $50\,\text{W}$ and lamp Q is rated $250\,\text{V}$, $200\,\text{W}$. The two lamps are connected in series to a $250\,\text{V}$ power supply.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram with lamps labelled P and Q in series with a switch, and terminals labelled 250 V.

stem.text: Assume that the resistance of each lamp remains constant.
Which statement most accurately describes what happens when the switch is closed?

A.text: Lamp P emits four times as much power as lamp Q.

B.text: Lamp P emits twice as much power as lamp Q.

C.text: Lamp Q emits four times as much power as lamp P.

D.text: Lamp Q emits twice as much power as lamp P.
